sentences.text: He is in the big library.
His friends are Mia and Sam.
It is a big, red book.
A paper is in the book.
A drawing is on the map.
It is a drawing of a chair.
The chair is in the library.
They go to the green chair.
The new paper has a drawing.
The drawing is a big clock.
They go to the big clock.
A small box is behind the clock.
Other students are near the clock.
Ben and Anna see the box.
Ben and Anna are not happy.
A key is in the box.
It is a very old key.
It is the key to a secret garden.
